integrity: All assertions rely on the stated principal-angle and scalar convexity proofs. Exact-rational and sampled scalar checks are reproducibility diagnostics only, not infinite proof or independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Finite-rank orthogonal projections and real exponents 3 through 5 only; no nonquartic extension to arbitrary positive operators; the p=4 specialization is an already published stronger identity. Constants at p!=4 are limiting; potential unindexed classical trace-stability literature remains a bibliographic risk. Independent audit not performed.
title: A sharp fourth-power transition in complementary McCarthy stability for projection pairs
